It started about three years ago, after my husband passed. I got this idea in my head that, before he died, he’d been sneaking around with another woman from the pub. I can’t shake it. I picture them together, hear them whispering about me when I’m trying to sleep, like they’re just outside the door. Sometimes, even at work washing dishes, I hear his voice, clear as day, arguing with her about keeping it secret from me, even though he’s been gone for years.

Most days I feel crushed, like there’s a heavy weight on my chest. I’m tired all the time, move slowly, and have to force myself to get to the kitchen. I don’t get any pleasure from anything anymore, just go through the motions. I feel worthless, stupid for not “seeing” it sooner, and I’ve had dark thoughts that maybe it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up.

There was a stretch, maybe a month, when the sadness eased a bit, but the certainty he’d cheated and the voices carried on just the same. Overall, though, the low mood and hopelessness have been there more often than not throughout these years.
